title.en: Green Revolution and the subsidy debate

heading.en: From ship to mouth to self-sufficiency

hook.en: In the early 1960s India depended on imported grain. Within about a decade it was producing enough food for itself. What changed on the farm?
hook.kn: 1960ರ ದಶಕದ ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ ಆಮದು ಧಾನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿತ್ತು. ಸುಮಾರು ಒಂದು ದಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಾವಲಂಬಿಯಾಯಿತು. ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಏನು ಬದಲಾಯಿತು?

objectives.en: Explain the Green Revolution and its phases
Discuss the debate on farm subsidies

narration.en: In the early 1960s India depended on imported grain. Within about a decade it was producing enough food for itself. What changed on the farm?

title.en: HYV seeds and the two phases

body.en: The Green Revolution was the large increase in food grain production from the use of high yielding variety (HYV) seeds, especially for wheat and rice. HYV seeds needed fertilisers, pesticides and regular water. In the first phase, mid-1960s to mid-1970s, HYV use was restricted to more affluent states such as Punjab, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, and mainly to wheat; in the second phase, mid-1970s to mid-1980s, it spread to more states and crops.
body.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇಳುವರಿ ತಳಿ (ಎಚ್‌ವೈವಿ) ಬೀಜಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯಿಂದ ಆಹಾರ ಧಾನ್ಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಭಾರೀ ಏರಿಕೆಯಾದುದೇ ಹಸಿರು ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ. ಮೊದಲ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಂಜಾಬ್, ಆಂಧ್ರ ಪ್ರದೇಶ, ತಮಿಳುನಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಗೋಧಿ; ಎರಡನೇ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳೆಗಳು.

points.en: HYV seeds + fertiliser + pesticide + assured water
India became self-sufficient in food grains
Marketed surplus: the part of output sold in the market by farmers

narration.en: The Green Revolution was the large increase in food grain production from the use of high yielding variety (HYV) seeds, especially for wheat and rice. HYV seeds needed fertilisers, pesticides and regular water. In the first phase, mid-1960s to mid-1970s, HYV use was restricted to more affluent states such as Punjab, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, and mainly to wheat; in the second phase, mid-1970s to mid-1980s, it spread to more states and crops.
narration.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇಳುವರಿ ತಳಿ (ಎಚ್‌ವೈವಿ) ಬೀಜಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯಿಂದ ಆಹಾರ ಧಾನ್ಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಭಾರೀ ಏರಿಕೆಯಾದುದೇ ಹಸಿರು ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ. ಮೊದಲ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಂಜಾಬ್, ಆಂಧ್ರ ಪ್ರದೇಶ, ತಮಿಳುನಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಗೋಧಿ; ಎರಡನೇ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳೆಗಳು.

body.en: Small farmers feared they could not afford the inputs and that HYV crops were prone to pests. The government gave loans at low interest and subsidised fertilisers, so small farmers also benefited. Subsidies encourage new technology, but economists argue that once a technology is accepted, subsidies mostly benefit the fertiliser industry and rich farmers and burden government finances.
body.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಒಳಸುರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಕೀಟಬಾಧೆಯ ಭಯವಿತ್ತು. ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ರಸಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಸಹಾಯಧನ ನೀಡಿತು. ಸಹಾಯಧನ ಹೊಸ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅದು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಲಾಭ ಎಂಬ ವಾದವೂ ಇದೆ.

points.en: For subsidies: needed to encourage small farmers to adopt new technology
Against: benefit rich farmers and the fertiliser industry; fiscal burden

narration.en: Small farmers feared they could not afford the inputs and that HYV crops were prone to pests. The government gave loans at low interest and subsidised fertilisers, so small farmers also benefited. Subsidies encourage new technology, but economists argue that once a technology is accepted, subsidies mostly benefit the fertiliser industry and rich farmers and burden government finances.

problem.en: A farmer harvests 120 quintals of wheat. His family keeps 25 quintals for food and 5 quintals as seed. What is his marketed surplus?

answer.en: 90 quintals is sold in the market.
